architecture.node_feature: frame-0 fractional position plus atom type

loading_context: initial box xyz, constant-velocity prescribed target x box length, observed frame-1-to-2 x-box velocity
targets: target yz box lengths; decoder is scaled as total displacement from frame 0 and mapped through a beta-10 softplus physical positivity constraint before box-length loss

evaluation.p_ratio: periodic-reference-aligned independent affine y/x and z/x fits

promotion_gate.candidate_ranking: highest minimum y/x or z/x p-ratio R2 at frame 399; lower position MSE breaks ties
promotion_gate.checkpoint_selection_note: p-ratio is used only for validation-level model-family promotion, never for training or checkpoint selection

smoke.train_ids: train[0:4] to give every static context channel nonzero training variance
